title: Democrats Sweep 2026 Midterms; Dow Posts Best Post-Election Day in 44 Years
summary: Democrats won control of both the House and Senate in Tuesday's midterm elections. Markets surged Wednesday: Dow +3% (best post-midterm session in 44 years), S&P 500 +1.58%, VIX fell nearly 20%, Brent crude fell ~3% with oil near $100/bbl, and spot gold rose ~2.9% to around $4,043/oz. Markets interpreted a split-Congress outcome as removing major political uncertainty.
why: 选举不确定性消除，VIX骤降约20%，对期权卖方友好；分裂国会预期下政策推进节奏趋缓，对长期利率路径影响有限；金价反弹至约4043美元/盎司，利好老铺黄金（6181.HK）等持金标的。

title: China Moves to Support Stocks With Buyback and Liquidity Measures
summary: China announced a third round of its securities swap facility (SFISF), eased share-buyback rules, cut the relending rate supporting buybacks from 1.25% to 1%, and plans to make the stock-support lending facility permanent. A major state-owned bank is reportedly considering extending up to 200 billion yuan in credit lines to two AMCs connected to the national team.
why: 国家队扩大入市工具，A股和港股底部支撑增强；回购贷款利率下调降低上市公司回购成本，对腾讯、美团等港股龙头可能形成提振；短期内波动率有望被压制，sell put安全边际提高。

title: Nvidia Can Only Fulfill ~1% of China's $70B GPU Order; Cloud Partners Told to Reduce China Exposure
summary: Chinese AI and cloud firms — including Alibaba, Tencent, and ByteDance — ordered roughly 6 million Nvidia RTX Pro 5500 chips but will receive only ~1% (about 60,000 units) within four months due to supply constraints. Separately, the Financial Times reported that Nvidia asked cloud computing clients to maintain at least 51% of capacity outside China, tightening US restrictions on Chinese AI computing access.
why: 美国对华AI芯片管制深化，英伟达中国客户实际可得GPU极少；对腾讯（0700.HK）、阿里巴巴（9988.HK）AI算力布局构成压制；中国云厂商被迫加速自研芯片，或利好国内AI芯片替代产业链；期权隐含波动率预期上升，半导体板块不确定性加大。

title: Fed Chair Warsh Plans Fewer Rate-Decision Meetings in 2027; Markets Eye December Hike
summary: Following the October 28 hold (rates kept at 3.75–4%), Fed Chair Kevin Warsh announced the FOMC will dedicate at least one of its eight annual scheduled meetings to broader policy deliberations rather than a rate vote starting 2027 — which economists say could delay rate relief for borrowers. Futures markets continue to price in a meaningful probability of a quarter-point hike at the December meeting.
why: 美联储结构性变化及加息预期继续压制成长股估值和利率敏感资产；进入12月前需密切关注美联储讲话及通胀数据；期权隐含波动率预计维持偏高，sell put需留意尾部风险。延续报道：10月28日美联储按兵不动决议持续在市场发酵。

title: Circle Q3 2026: Revenue +17% to $865M, USDC On-Chain Volume Surges 49%; GENIUS Act Effective Jan 2027
summary: Circle Internet Group (CRCL) reported Q3 2026 revenue of $865 million, up 17% year over year. USDC on-chain transaction volume rose 49% to $13.9 trillion, capturing 79% of all stablecoin transaction volume. The OCC finalized GENIUS Act rules with the full act taking effect January 18, 2027. Morgan Stanley cut its price target to $34 (from $37) citing USDC circulation growth concerns.
why: GENIUS Act监管框架落地时间轴明确（2027年1月18日），Circle合规先发优势凸显；但USDC发行量环比增长较慢，摩根士丹利下调目标价，分析师分歧加大；稳定币法案落地对整体加密市场有里程碑意义，可关注隐含波动率变化。

title: 美团设定80亿元离岸人民币债券条款，主要用于再融资
summary: 美团于11月3日确定80亿元离岸人民币债券发行条款：45亿元2031年到期票据票面利率2.50%，35亿元2036年到期票据票面利率3.10%，均平价发行，所得款项主要用于偿还现有离岸债务。
why: 美团以低利率延长偿债期限，改善资产负债表流动性；2.50%-3.10%的利率反映市场对其信用的认可；再融资完成后财务压力降低，或有助于减少有效期权波动率。
